result.summary: The page is generally well-structured and visually consistent. One minor content issue was found: a typo in the search bar placeholder text. The partially visible carousel item on the right and the card cut off at the bottom are expected scrolling behaviors and not defects.

issues.description: The search bar placeholder reads 'Restarants, dishes, groceries' — 'Restarants' is misspelled (should be 'Restaurants').
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder text to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.
